nodes.label: State Synchronization Facade
nodes.rationale: UI layer strictly consumes useFinanceData facade, preventing direct dependencies on Zustand or Supabase.

nodes.label: Autonomous Notification Scheduler Engine
nodes.rationale: Autonomous scheduling across Web/PWA and Android with debounced re-evaluation, 45-day deduplication, and Doze mode support.

nodes.label: Finance Pal Core Product Spec
nodes.rationale: Personal finance app built with React 18, Vite, TypeScript 5.8, Capacitor, and Supabase for local-first zero-commitment privacy.

nodes.label: Antigravity Architect Role Contract
nodes.rationale: Architect agent specifies folder structure, dependencies, and types in .agent/task.md without writing final implementation.

nodes.label: Local-First Architecture Pattern
nodes.rationale: Optimistic in-memory local state reading/writing via Zustand and async cloud synchronization via React Query and Supabase.

nodes.label: Virtual Debt Transactions Engine
nodes.rationale: Debt payments are rendered on-the-fly as virtual transactions using useMemo rather than polluting physical transactions table.

nodes.label: CI Build and Verification Workflow
nodes.rationale: Automated verification with Node 20: npm audit, TypeScript typechecking, Vitest coverage, and production bundle build.

nodes.label: Pre-Penetration Test Security Scope
nodes.rationale: Audit checklist covering Supabase REST/Realtime, RLS policies across 11 tables, client storage encryption, and Capacitor Android.
